_not_mutated.coveredBy full-containment: Weakening coveredBy to accept PARTIAL overlap (lo >= sp.lo && lo < sp.hi) was tried and is NOT CATCHABLE by any test, so it is deliberately absent rather than left surviving in the report. The reason is structural: reBase64ish's charset excludes newline, and every structured span this file computes either ends at a line boundary (a go.sum digest, the sops metadata block) or is delimited by a character outside the charset (the comma after an ENC payload, the quote after an SRI payload). So no run can begin inside an exempt span and continue past its end, and the two spellings are equivalent on every input the scan can be handed. The strict form is kept because it is the correct statement of intent for a future format whose fields are not line-delimited; a mutation report claiming it is unguarded would be noise, and a surviving mutant nobody can act on trains readers to ignore the report.
